body:
`config_kobo_cover_padding_enabled` defaults TRUE (cps/config_sql.py:153). The Kobo cover route
(cps/kobo.py:1839) calls `_serve_padded_cover_if_enabled` -> `pad_path_to_cache` -> `pad_blob`
(cps/services/cover_preview.py:511-560): Wand decode, mirror/blur composite, JPEG re-encode.
That is roughly 100-500ms of C work per miss, on the request greenlet.

This app serves gevent WITHOUT monkey.patch_all(). Wand releases the GIL, but the hub's own
thread is the one inside the C call, so no other greenlet runs until it returns.

The cache is keyed by (book, resolution, source mtime, settings hash) under the thumbnails dir
(cover_preview.py:736+), so it is cold after container recreation when that dir is not
persistent, after any cover change, and after any padding-settings change. On the maintainer's
instance the preview cache reports empty (`before=0 after=0 evicted=0`), so every cover fetch is
currently a miss.

A first sync of N books is therefore N serialized stalls — several seconds aggregate — during
which the web UI is frozen too.

Fix: offload the miss path with `parallel.run_blocking`. The hit path is `send_from_directory`
and is fine as-is. Build any Flask-context-dependent values before the hop.
title: Kobo cover padding runs ImageMagick on the request greenlet on every cache miss
